traits.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), under Psilotaceae and Psilotum: often epiphytic, rootless plants with a forking rhizome and green aerial branches that fork in pairs; leaf-like or scale-like appendages set in spirals or seemingly two-ranked; sporangia on short side branches.

traits.life_span.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 99, 100, family Psilotaceae: life span perennial; read as "perennial".

traits.rhizome_habit.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 99, 100, family Psilotaceae: rhizome habit long_creeping (horizontal rhizome); read as "long_creeping".

traits.anchorage.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 99, 100, family Psilotaceae: anchorage rhizoids (roots absent); read as "rhizoids".
